title: Holmes Medium Pebbled Leather Convertible Messenger Bag
description_html:
Holmes Medium Pebbled Leather Convertible Messenger Bag by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 11.75”W X 8”H X 5”D
  • Handle Drop: Handle drop: 8.5""
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., Pebbled leather
  • Hardware: Antique gold-tone hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
  • Closure: Snap fastening
